```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
url <- "https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/320/student+performance.zip"

download.file(url,"../data/raw/student_performance.zip", mode = "wb")
unzip("../data/raw/student_performance.zip", exdir = "../data/raw")
unzip("../data/raw/student.zip", exdir = "../data/raw")
student_math <- read_delim("../data/raw/student-mat.csv", delim = ";")

file.remove("../data/raw/student_performance.zip", "../data/raw/student.zip")
```

```{r}
student_math_clean <- student_math |> 
  select(paid, Medu, Fedu, Mjob, Fjob, famsize, Pstatus, studytime, 
         failures, famsup, school, address) |> 
  rename(paid_classes = paid,
         mother_edu = Medu,
         father_edu = Fedu,
         mother_job = Mjob,
         father_job = Fjob,
         family_size = famsize, 
         parent_status = Pstatus, 
         past_failures = failures,
         family_support = famsup
         ) |> 
  mutate(address = case_when(address == "U" ~ "urban", 
                             address == "R" ~ "rural"),
         parent_status = case_when(parent_status == "T" ~ "together",
                                   parent_status == "A" ~ "apart"),
         family_size = case_when(family_size == "LE3" ~ "3 or fewer", 
                                 family_size == "GT3" ~ "greater than 3"),
         school = case_when(school == "GP" ~ "Gabriel Pereira",
                            school == "MS" ~ "Mousinho da Silveira")) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) |> 
  mutate(studytime = factor(studytime, levels = 1:4,
                            labels = c("<2 hours", "2-5 hours", 
                                       "5-10 hours", ">10 hours")),
         paid_classes = factor(paid_classes, levels = c("yes", "no")))
  

write_csv(student_math_clean, "../data/processed/student_math_clean.csv")

head(student_math_clean)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
library(reticulate)
use_virtualenv("../.venv", required = TRUE)
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
```

```{python}
math_student = pd.read_csv("../data/processed/student_math_clean.csv")

# Splitting the data into 75% training and 25% test
train_df, test_df = train_test_split(math_student, test_size = 0.25, stratify=math_student["paid_classes"], random_state = 522)

train_df.to_csv("../data/processed/student_math_train.csv", index=False)
test_df.to_csv("../data/processed/student_math_test.csv", index=False)

print(train_df.shape, test_df.shape)
print(train_df["paid_classes"].value_counts())
```
